summary: A bank-only shortcut answers all 4 delivered candidates and all 24 fresh hard samples without using the curve. The sole captured hard inventory entry has the same defect. Other checks passed; package files remain unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Differentiate a general-base composite exponential using the chain rule, then evaluate the slope and ordinate and construct a tangent equation.
reasoning_steps: Identify the inner polynomial and differentiate the outer exponential.
Multiply the derivatives using the chain rule.
Evaluate the derivative and function at the supplied point.
Use point-slope form and match the resulting tangent equation.
invariants: Hard source q-107463 requires a tangent equation in a five-choice radio bank.
The derivative, evaluation point, ordinate and keyed equation must agree.
The captured source-exclusion ledger is empty.
permitted_variations: Vary bases, coefficients, translations and evaluation points within comparable exact-arithmetic workload.
Vary slope signs, intercepts, correct-choice positions and distractor roles.
The source example's fixed answer-bearing bank arrangement is incidental.

source_replay.details: Replayed all 14 source/canonical profiles. Captured complete banks match mathematically. Missing source fields and supported presentation corrections are documented; no excluded-source descendants were found.

math.details: All 48 independently checked records agree with exact differentiation, evaluation and tangent construction. Radio alternatives were checked individually.

variety.details: Fresh hard samples cover both slope signs, bases 2 through 6 and all three evaluation points. Controlled relevant changes update the tangent; irrelevant order changes preserve it. This does not waive the separate shortcut failure.

scope.details: Paths cover source response shapes, tested hard boundaries and every batch record. Necessary logarithm rewrites are source-supported and displayed. An equivalent answer requiring an omitted conversion fails the negative control.

grading.details: The native grader produced 50 accepted and 175 rejected submissions, with no unresolved outcomes. Tests include every hard choice, independent equivalent blank entries, plausible wrong entries and controlled pairs.

rendering.details: Rendered 11 records through the actual UI and inspected representative screenshots. Every expected equation container and multiline row appears in the DOM. Shared prose-boundary checks passed; no exposed TeX or code-trapped formulas appeared. Text choices, feedback, emphasis wrappers and tables are absent from this hard family.

packaging.details: Installed dependency versions exactly match the manifest. Relocated CLI execution reproduces the batch, invalid parameter boundaries are rejected, and package hashes remain unchanged.

decision_variation.details: A bank-only coefficient/sign/constant rule succeeds on 24/24 fresh, 6/6 controlled and 4/4 delivered records, including every tested point subgroup. It also succeeds on the original complete bank. A same-method witness demonstrates that this fixed arrangement is avoidable without changing the assessed skill.

findings.description: The hard bank encodes its key: identify the majority slope sign, take its repeated x coefficient, then choose that coefficient's option with a positive standalone rational constant. This selects the correct equation without consulting the curve. The cue also exists in the original bank, but retaining that incidental arrangement is unnecessary.
findings.reproduction: Generate hard with seed 72 and parameters {b:3,c:1,a:2,n:1,k:0,l:0,d:1,point:"0"}. For y=3^(2x+1) at x=0, bank slopes are 6ln3, -6ln3, -6ln3, 12ln3 and 6ln3. The rule selects y=6x ln3+3. Question UUID: 68b2825f-3857-5c32-8ef8-b848aea295ca. Run the context Python on shortcut-regression.py --candidate-records minimal-failing-case.json --output prospective-probe.json; it exits 1. The accepted batch similarly fails 4/4.
findings.requested_change: Change the hard tangent distractor-construction rule so correct slope/intercept roles cannot be inferred from bank repetition, signs and constant structure. Preserve five distinct equations, one correct answer and the existing chain-rule/point-slope workload. Retain an executable regression and test a prospective deterministic batch using seed 1072510293, count 4 and hard difficulty through actual delivery filtering. Do not edit runner-owned samples.json or substitute another seed.
